# Qt

EmuLoader ReLoaded is built with Qt 6.4.2 (https://www.qt.io), by The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
Qt is used under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 (`Qt-LGPL-3.0.txt`, which adds to the GNU
General Public License, version 3: `Qt-GPL-3.0.txt`).

Qt's libraries are separate files next to EmuLoader-ReLoaded.exe (`Qt6Core.dll`, `Qt6Gui.dll`, `Qt6Widgets.dll`
and the plugins in the `platforms`, `styles` and `imageformats` folders). They can be replaced with other builds
of the same Qt version, built from the same source with changes of your own.

Qt's source code: https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.4/6.4.2/single/ and https://code.qt.io. EmuLoader
ReLoaded uses Qt as it is, without changes.
